name: Svelte-class Imperial shuttle
description: The Svelte-class Imperial shuttle was a multi-purpose transport utilized by the Imperial Remnant that was designed as a more aggressive replacement for the aging Lambda-class T-4a shuttle of the Galactic Empire.
